html.help.p.setup:
• Mac: System Settings → Wallpaper → Add picture.
  • Windows: Right-click the file → Set as desktop background.
  • iPhone: Open in Photos → Share → Use as wallpaper.
  • Android: Long-press home screen → Wallpaper → Choose photo.
html.help.p.guarantee: 14-day money-back on Essential, 30 days on Premium. Details in our Terms and Withdrawal policy.
